changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionConditionItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetVersionConditionUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ConditionType] [int] NOT NULL, [ConditionFieldTypeID] [int] NULL, [ConditionIntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [Operator] [int] NOT NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_Uid] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_FieldType') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_FieldType] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_IntersectType') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_IntersectType] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem] ON [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] ( [AssetVersionConditionUid] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem] ON [metrics].[CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
